We have now made our way into Day 2 of the massive Amazon Black Friday sale with all-time lows on Apple Watch Series 12, AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off, MacBook Neo from $649, and a fantastic price drop on the most affordable M5 MacBook Air at $1,049. However, Amazon has now dropped the price even lower on AirPods Max 2 at $130 off, we have iPhone Air new unlocked at nearly $300 off for Black Friday (or Best Buy open-box units up to a massive $799 off), and loads of deals on Beats headphones and buds at up to 53% off the list prices (the new 360 are now $100 off). Those deals join the ongoing all-time lows on M6 MacBook Pro at $150 off, Apple Studio Displays at $200 off, and a brilliant deal on the Twelve South AirFly Drive Wireless CarPlay Adapter at $32. Check it all out below.

That’s $150 off and $50 under the next best price of 2026. If the FusionDock Ultra is a bit overkill for you, the FusionDock Max 2 is a more affordable alternative that still delivers the Thunderbolt 5 and multi-display connectivity you need for a capable Mac workstation – it’s now down at $359.99 from the regular $449.99 for Black Friday.

While deals on iPad have been underwhelming as of late, there are price drops live across the M5 iPad Pro lineup, just make sure to pay special attention to this one model at nearly $300 off.

But the really notable deal here is landing on the 11-inch 1TB M5 iPad Pro in both the Silver and Space Black colorways at $1,499.99 shipped – that’s just shy of $300 off the list price.

Regularly $1,799, this model is now a whole lot less pricey than it has been over the last several months, landing at $299 off the list price and delivering arguably the best deal we are tracking on iPad for Black Friday thus far.
